rationale: Jia Jin's experience building NimbleRx, a YC-backed automation and delivery company, pairs well with Colin's deep expertise in AI infrastructure and developer tooling—areas where pharmacy tech increasingly intersects with modern cloud systems. Colin's work bridging GPU infrastructure to builders, combined with his mentorship background in developer relations and ecosystem building, could help Jia think through how to architect and scale technical solutions in a competitive space.
intro_message: Jia Jin, meet Colin Nebius — he's spent 20 years bridging cutting-edge infrastructure (GPU clouds, AI tooling) with the builders who use it, and his experience scaling developer ecosystems might spark ideas for how you approach automation and delivery tech.
